title: 선주상호보험조합법 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Terms and Conditions): The terms and conditions of insurance as defined in Article 14(2)(3) of the Act must include the following:

1. Reasons for payment of insurance benefits
2. Grounds for invalidity of the insurance contract
3. Exclusions of the association
4. Obligations of the association and the timing of their fulfillment
5. Losses incurred by the association if a member fails to fulfill their obligations
6. Grounds for termination of the insurance contract and the rights and obligations of the association and its members in the event of termination
